style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: Krishna calls Arjuna dear and says he will speak only his good
candidates.evidence: इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् (you are dear to me, so I will speak for your good)

candidates.angle: sarvaguhyatamam, the most secret, is revealed again
Krishna promises a supreme word because Arjuna is dear to him
candidates.evidence: इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति (you are dear to me, truly)

angle_en: Isthah asi: because you are dear
angle_hi: इष्टोऽसि: क्योंकि तू मेरा प्रिय है

en.intro: Krishna has just told Arjuna to reflect on the secret wisdom and then choose his own path. Now he asks him to listen once more.
en.notice: Krishna names the reason for his final command: Arjuna is dear to him, and therefore he will speak only what is truly good for him.
en.next: Because Arjuna is dear to him, Krishna now gives the final command to fix his mind on him.
en.meaning: Listen again to My most secret word. You are dear to Me, so I will speak for your good.

hi.intro: कृष्णा ने अर्जुन से कहा है कि वह इस गुप्त ज्ञान पर विचार करे और फिर अपनी इच्छा से करे। अब वह अर्जुन से एक बार फिर सुनने को कहते हैं।
hi.meaning: कृष्ण कहते हैं, मेरे इस सबसे गुप्त वचन को फिर से सुनो। तू मेरा अत्यन्त प्रिय है, इसलिए मैं तेरे हित की बात कहूँगा।
hi.notice: कृष्ण कारण बताते हैं कि यह अंतिम उपदेश क्यों है: अर्जुन उनके प्रिय हैं, इसलिए वे केवल वही कहेंगे जो अर्जुन के लिए वास्तव में हितकर हो।
hi.next: चूंकि अर्जुन उनके प्रिय हैं, इसलिए कृष्ण अब अंतिम आदेश देते हैं कि अपना मन मुझमें लगा और मेरा भक्त बन।

en.intro: Krishna has just told Arjuna to reflect on the secret wisdom and then choose his own path. Now he asks him to listen once more.
en.body: Listen again to My most secret word. You are dear to Me, so I will speak for your good. Krishna names the reason for his final command: Arjuna is dear to him, and therefore he will speak only what is truly good for him. Because Arjuna is dear to him, Krishna now gives the final command to fix his mind on him.
